headline: Approved library renovation schematic design and budget estimate, plus $14,321.44 in October bills.
summary: DesignLAB Architects presented the current schematic design layout and budget estimate for the building renovation. Speakers during public comment expressed support for a library staff collective bargaining agreement.
decisions: Accepted and filed electronic communication received for public comment, 5-0.
Approved payment of October 2026 library bills of $14,321.44 from the regular budget and $98.81 from the Fines account, 5-0.
Approved spending up to $1,700 from the Stearns Trust for choral read board book sets, 5-0.
Approved the library renovation schematic design and budget estimate as proposed, 5-0.

$1,700 from Stearns Trust for choral read board book sets
Library building renovation schematic design and budget estimate
plain_text:
Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees  
November 4, 2026  
7:00 PM  
MINUTES 
A meeting of the Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees was held Wednesday, November 4, 2026, 
scheduled at 7:00 PM at the Nashua Public Library, 2 Court Street, Nashua, NH, 03060  
1. Call to Order 
 
  
 
DRAFT 
 
 
 
Chairman Laflamme called the meeting to order at 7:02 PM. 
2. Attendance 
 
 Present: Linda Laflamme, Scott Jaquith, Kristin Kane, Ernest Jette, John Kennedy, Library Director 
Jennifer McCormack, Assistant Library Director Jenn Hosking. 
 
Thirty members of the public. 
3. Correspondence 
Vote to accept and place on file 
 
 Motion by Mr. Jette, seconded by Ms. Kane, to accept and file electronic communication received 
for public comment. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No 0 
Motion: PASSED 
4. Public Comment 
 
 Motion by Mr. Jaquith, seconded by Mr. Kennedy, to hold a 15-minute public comment session, 
move to DesignLAB's presentation, then return to public session for the remainder of the public 
signed up to speak. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
 
Joseph Hatch, Faith Eherts, Ben Heney, Mark King, Jon Blanchete, Eve Arnold expressed support 
for a library staff collective bargaining agreement. 
 
Motion by Mr. Jette, seconded by Mr. Kennedy, to finish public comment then move to DesignLAB's 
presentation. 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
 
Jo Gilson, Susan Carey, Bill McIntyre, Jaclyn Zajak, Kylie Hargrove, Melissa Huske expressed 
support for a library staff collective bargaining agreement. 
5. Approval of bills and trust fund requests 
 
 Motion by Mr. Kennedy, seconded by Mr. Jaquith, to approve payment of the library bills from
October 2026 from the regular budget for $14,321.44 and $$98.81 from the Fines account. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
 
Motion by Mr. Kennedy, seconded by Ms. Kane, to expend up to $1,700 from the Stearns Trust to 
purchase choral read board book sets to be used during story time. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
6. Approval of minutes from previous meetings 
 
 Motion by Mr. Jaquith, seconded by Mr. Kennedy to approve the October 6, 2026 meeting minutes. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
 
Motion by Mr. Kennedy, seconded by Ms. Kane to approve the October 28, 2026 meeting minutes. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
7. Presentation by Design Lab 
 
 DesignLAB Architects presented the current schematic design layout and project budget estimate of 
the library building renovation. 
 
Motion by Mr. Jaquith, seconded by Mr. Kennedy to approve the library renovation schematic 
design and budget estimate as proposed. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED 
8. Updates by members 
 
 None. 
9. Adjourn 
 
 Motion by Mr. Kennedy, seconded by Mr. Jaquith, to adjourn the meeting at 8:55 PM. 
 
Vote: Yes, 5, No, 0 
Motion: PASSED
